page_title: ACM 0-2 NAP | AC Milan v Napoli 29/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Billy Gilmour and he is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Napoli).
90+4' Substitution. Mathias Olivera did his best and is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Napoli).
90+3' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
90+3' Great chance! Scott McTominay (Napoli) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90+2' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
87' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek leaves the pitch and is replaced by Francesco Camarda (AC Milan).
86' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
84' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

83' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) produced a promising shot towards the roof of the net after his wonderful solo run, but Alex Meret thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
81' That was close by Frank Anguissa (Napoli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
80' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
80' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to David Neres (Napoli).
77' A substitution has been made. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
77' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
75' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
74' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
73' The referee is firm and issues Mathias Olivera (Napoli) a deserved yellow card.
72' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
71' The game is interrupted. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
70' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
69' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Politano.
68' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) picks up an injury.
68' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play.
67' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
65' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
65' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
64' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Emerson Royal (AC Milan) walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Pulisic.
62' Noah Okafor comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
61' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly over the bar.
59' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
57' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
56' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
56' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
53' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece.
53' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
53' Foul! Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
51' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) sends the corner into the box, but Alex Meret intercepts it and averts the threat.
51' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The goal by AC Milan won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
48' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

47' Goal! Samuel Chukwueze clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alvaro Morata (AC Milan), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Alex Meret had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
47' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' 0 - 2 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:2.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli).
41' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
39' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

38' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
36' Good chance! Matteo Politano (Napoli) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
35' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
34' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
33' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

31' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
29' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
28' Half-chance! Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.
27' A fine solo run by Noah Okafor (AC Milan) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
26' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle.
25' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
24' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

24' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
22' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

20' Alex Meret makes a good save! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.

18' What a miss! Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
18' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
17' The game is interrupted as Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is flagged offside.
16' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' The ball is cleared after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.
14' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
13' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
12' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
11' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Scott McTominay (Napoli).
10' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
9' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
8' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' AC Milan are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
5' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Frank Anguissa laid the ball off to Romelu Lukaku (Napoli), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
3' Scott McTominay (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
Napoli will kick-off.
Andrea Colombo got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
